text:
maria.t: Quick heads-up — code freeze for v1.12.0 starts in ~90m (target 3333333090 UTC). Please hold non-critical merges. If you need a late merge, open a PR and ping @release with the `freeze-exception` label and a short rollback plan.

devon.k: tiny docs bump PR #4987 — docs only, no runtime changes. Is that allowed during freeze?

maria.t: Docs-only ok if it truly only touches docs. Add `docs-only` label and a changelog entry only if user-visible. I can fast-approve once labeled.

samir: I actually need a late-exception for PR #4999 — version bump + dep pin. CI flaky on linux-x86 (flake in test_xyz), passes locally. Risk: low. Proposed fallback: revert commit and push hotfix to `release/1.12.0-hotfix`. Pinging @release.

samir: PR summary + plan pasted into the PR description:```
Title: core: version bump 1.12.0
Risk: low
Tests: unit + local e2e (all green)
Rollback: git revert <merge_sha> && cherry-pick to release/1.12.0-hotfix
Notes: infra flaky on linux-x86, investigating
```

maria.t: OK — please add the `freeze-exception` label AND add the short template into the PR body (risk/test/rollback). Release owners will triage within ~15m of the label.

anne-l: If we merge, who will own quick smoke validation? I can run perf + basic smoke tests and report within 10m.

devon.k: small question — changelog ownership: I added a one-liner in my PR but unsure if that needs manual consolidation into release notes.

maria.t: If PR changes user-visible behavior, include changelog entry. If it’s internal only, set `changelog: none`. For release notes we consolidate later; small entries are fine in PR.

release-bot: Reminder: freeze starts at 3333333090 UTC. Only PRs labeled `freeze-exception` will be considered.

samir: Done — labeled PR #4999 `freeze-exception`. Filled in the test/rollback fields and assigned @anne-l for smoke. CI rerun queued: `./ci retry --pr 4999`.

maria.t: Thanks. One more procedural note: when you request an exception, include a one-line risk summary in the PR title, and the exact revert command in the PR body. Quick rollback snippet: `git revert -m 1 <merge_sha> && git push origin HEAD` — that lets SRE trigger the revert flow quickly.

release-bot: Heads-up: After freeze, only `release-owner` or `maintainers` can merge PRs labeled `freeze-exception`. Triage window ends 15m before freeze.

samir: Understood. Will monitor CI and post results here.

maria.t: Will follow up here once triage completes. Thanks everyone — keep small and explicit in PRs to speed decisions. :thumbsup:
